related_questions.question: Does Medicare cover COVID test kits?

text_blocks.snippet: No, Medicare does not currently cover over-the-counter (OTC) COVID-19 test kits. While Medicare did cover these tests during a demonstration period that ended in May 2023, that coverage is no longer in effect, according to the Health and Human Services, Office of Inspector General (.gov). PCR tests, often administered at doctor's offices or testing sites, are still available and covered by Medicare without copay or coinsurance, according to Wellcare.
